chapter: The Blue Room and Lou Forbes band
title: Opening of the Blue Room and its succession of bandleaders
summary: The Blue Room opened with Jay Castle, then Gordon Kirst, Lou Forbes and Mickey Albert before closing.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. New Year's Eve opening, the blue room will be open from 10 until closing. This is an invitation. This was music by Jay Castle and his orchestra. Well, Jay Castle opened the room, but he didn't stay very long. How long did he stay? Long enough for Gordon Kirst to get the job.
How long was he around? About six months. He was around about six months.
Five dollars it cost. Who came after Kirst? Lou Forbes.
Until September, about three months, four months. Then Mickey Albert came in, and that's when they closed.
Here's the blue room there, with Gordon Kirst playing, leading. This is a... Oh, wow. Oh, wow. Louie Macenthal was playing bass. Uh-huh. We had Duke Ellington uniforms, almost.
